details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is fully coherent internally. There are no self-contradictions: all statements align logically (e.g., the decline in net profit is explained by non-recurring effects in S4). Explanations and comparisons follow logically from preceding statements (e.g., S2 explains revenue growth, S4 explains net profit decline, S11-S12 show segment performance drivers). The organization is clear and progressive, moving from overall performance to segment details, financial position, and strategic initiatives. There is no unnecessary repetition that reduces clarity. While segment figures (e.g., S9 cargo tonnage drop) are not reconciled to consolidated totals, the candidate does not claim they should sum exhaustively, so this does not constitute an internal contradiction. The summary forms a coherent whole, demonstrating enhanced stability, capital discipline, and strategic execution.
